cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SHADOWSEER
3 7" 4+ 9
MIRROR OF MINDS 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one enemy operative that’s a valid target
for and within 8" of this operative. Both players roll five D6.
Pair your dice with your opponent’s dice based on matching
results. For each matching pair, inflict D3 damage on that
enemy operative (to a maximum of 8). For example, if you
rolled 6, 5, 5, 2, 1 and your opponent rolled 6, 5, 4, 3, 1,
you would inflict 3D3 damage on that enemy operative.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.
FOG OF DREAMS 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one ready enemy operative visible to this
operative and roll one D6. Until the end of the turning point,
that enemy operative cannot be activated or perform actions
until it’s the last enemy operative to be activated, or until
your opponent has activated a number of enemy operatives
after this action equal to the result of the D6 (whichever
comes first).
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
杀戮小队
原型：渗透，侦查
特工
↘ 1 名虚空舞者剧团主演特工，从以下选项中
各选择一件装备：
○ 熔融手枪、神经干扰枪或者星镖手枪
○ 丑角之刃、丑角之抚、丑角之拥、丑角
之吻或者动力武器
↘ 7 名虚空舞者剧团特工，从以下列表选择：
• 死亡小丑
• 演员，从以下选项中各选择一件装备：
○ 熔融手枪、神经干扰枪或者星镖手枪
○ 丑角之刃、丑角之抚、丑角之拥或者丑
角之吻
• 暗影先知，装备有迷幻毒气榴弹以及以下
一种选项：:
○ 神经干扰枪；迷雾法杖
○ 星镖手枪；迷雾法杖
请继续阅读背面

cards.text:
除了演员特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被纳
入您的杀戮小队一次。您的杀戮小队至多只能包
含一把熔融手枪以及一把神经干扰枪。
cards.text_en:
Other than PLAYER operatives, your kill team can
only include each operative on this list once. Your
kill team can only include up to one fusion pistol
and up to one neuro disruptor.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
阵营规则
剧目
虚空舞者剧团从网道中出击时会进行演出。首
先，是一名独角扮演的关键角色出场，并在随
后的战斗中逐渐加入剧团的其他成员。
作为第一个转折点中的一个战略计划，您必须为
您的杀戮小队选择战斗中的一个寓言，并且一名
己方虚空舞者剧团特工会在战斗中成为关键角
色，当一名己方特工成为关键角色，它便会获得
您战斗中寓言对应的嘉奖规则。
作为每个后续转折点中的一个战略计划，您可以
选择一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工获得您战斗中
寓言对应的嘉奖规则。
每个转折点限一次，当成为关键角色的一名己方
特工完成了您寓言中的表演，则您可以选择一名
己方虚空舞者剧团特工获得您战斗中寓言对应
的嘉奖规则。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FACTION RULE
SAEDATH
Void-dancer Troupes put on a performance as they attack
from the Webway. A single player begins in the pivotal
role, then the rest of the troupe progressively join in.
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point,
you must select an ALLEGORY (Epic or Melodrama
below) for your kill team for the battle, and one
friendly VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative to
have the PIVOTAL ROLE for the battle. Whenever a
friendly operative has the PIVOTAL ROLE, it has the
ACCOLADE rule of your ALLEGORY for the battle.
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in each subsequent
turning point, you can select one friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative to gain the
ACCOLADE rule of your ALLEGORY for the battle.
Once per turning point, when a friendly operative
that has the PIVOTAL ROLE completes the
performance of your ALLEGORY, you can select
one friendly VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative
to gain the ACCOLADE rule of your ALLEGORY for
the battle.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
史诗
表演：特工在近战中使一名敌方特工残废。
嘉奖：每当该特工进行近战时，其近战武器获
得“平衡”武器规则。
情节剧
表演：特工在通过进行射击使一名敌方特工残
废。
嘉奖：特工的远程武器获得“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
Epic
Performance: The operative incapacitates an
enemy operative while fighting.
Accolade: Whenever this operative is fighting, its
melee weapons have the Balanced weapon rule.
Melodrama
Performance: The operative incapacitates an
enemy operative while shooting.
Accolade: The operative’s ranged weapons have
the Balanced weapon rule.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
阵营规则
盛装丑角
丑角舞动的装备能给予他们额外的机动力，使
他们极难被瞄准，轻松躲开等离子和热熔武器
的精准射击。
每当一名特工对一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工执
行射击时，如果没有攻击骰被作为关键成功保
留，那么将“穿刺”武器规则的数值弱化 1 点
（若有)。请注意，这意味着“穿刺 1”武器规则
将被无视。
每当一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工向上进行攀爬
时，您可以将垂直距离视为 2"（无论实际垂直移
动距离为多少）。
己方虚空舞者剧团特工可以在移动中进入敌方
特工的控制范围内（但依然需要在那次移动的开
始与结束时符合所有条件）。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FACTION RULE
HARLEQUIN’S PANOPLY
The tools of the Harlequins' trade afford them additional
mobility and make them highly difficult to target,
enabling them to dodge away from piercing shots of
plasma and melta fire.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative, and no attack
dice are retained as critical successes, worsen
the x of the Piercing weapon rule by 1 (if any).
Note that Piercing 1 would therefore be ignored.
Whenever a friendly VOID-DANCER
TROUPE operative is climbing up, you can treat
the vertical distance as 2" (regardless of how far
the operative actually moves vertically).
Friendly VOID-DANCER TROUPE operatives can
move within control range of enemy operatives
(they must still start and end the move following
all requirements for that move).

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
战略计谋
疾速突袭
随着丑角在行进中开火后跃身躲开还击，他们
展现出一道道耀眼的多彩幻影。
每当一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工在它的激活中
执行转移行动时，它可以在那次行动中执行射击
行动（它必须被放置在一个可以被放置的位置，
并且可以随后继续使用那次转移行动中剩余的移
动距离）。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
STRATEGY PLOY
DARTING SALVO
Advancing in a dazzling blurr of vibrant colour,
Harlequins fire on the move, leaping away before their
opponents can return fire.
Whenever a friendly VOID-DANCER TROUPE
operative performs the Reposition action during
its activation, it can perform the Shoot action
during that action (it must do so in a location it
can be placed, and any remaining move distance
it had from that Reposition action can be used
after it does so).

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
战略计谋
渐入佳境
随着一次次跃进与致命舞步，剧团的演出节奏
不断加快，直冲暴力顶峰。
一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工可以在执行了冲锋
行动的同一个激活中执行冲刺行动，但反之不可
（即不能在冲刺后执行冲锋）。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
STRATEGY PLOY
RISING CRESCENDO
With each darting advance and lethal flourish, the
tempo of the troupe’s performance increases, building
towards a violent crescendo.
Friendly VOID-DANCER TROUPE operatives
can perform the Dash action during the
same activation in which they performed the
Charge action, but not vice versa (i.e. not Dash
then Charge).

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
战略计谋
棱镜模糊
丑角们是如此的敏捷且耀眼，即便是最老练的
射手也难以瞄准这些轻盈的身躯。
每当一名特工对在这个转折点进行过移动的一名
己方虚空舞者剧团特工执行射击时，您可以重
掷一枚己方防御骰子。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
STRATEGY PLOY
PRISMATIC BLUR
So swift and dazzling are the Harlequins that even
veteran marksmen struggle to draw a bead upon their
lithe forms.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative that
performed an action in which it moved during
this turning point, you can re-roll one of your
defence dice.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
战略计谋
乔高奇的玩笑
通过近身与舞者肉搏的尝试鲜少成功。那些
不幸的刺客们会发现那些精准打击面对的只
有空气。
当一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工处于近战或反击
中，并且您的对手使用普通成功出击时，您可以
掷一枚 D6：若掷骰结果低于您对手选择武器的
命中属性，则那个出击被格挡（忽视“残暴”武
器规则，如果有），并且您在这个流程中无法再
次使用本规则。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
STRATEGY PLOY
CEGORACH’S JEST
Attempts to engage the troupe in melee combat meet
with little success. Luckless assailants find their well-
aimed strikes meeting only thin air.
Whenever a friendly VOID-DANCER
TROUPE operative is fighting or retaliating and
your opponent strikes with a normal success,
you can roll one D6: if the result is less than the
Hit stat of your opponent’s selected weapon,
that strike is allocated to block one of your
dice instead (ignore the Brutal weapon rule, if
relevant) and you cannot use this rule for the rest
of the sequence.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
交战计谋
致命登场
丑角的突袭以惊人的速度浮现——往往在对方
举刀反击之前，一连串劈砍早已落下。
在一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工在执行了冲锋行
动的激活中执行近战行动时，您进行出击后使用
本交战计谋。您可以立即将另一枚普通成功，若
没有普通成功则选择另一枚关键成功结算为出击
（在您的对手之前）。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
MURDEROUS ENTRANCE
The Harlequin assault materialises with terrifying speed,
a flurry of deadly blows landing before the foe can raise
a blade in response.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative is fighting
during an activation in which it performed
the Charge action, after you strike. You can
immediately resolve another of your normal
successes as a strike (before your opponent),
or one of your critical successes if there are none.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
交战计谋
闭幕
在造成致命打击后，丑角们迅速脱离，留下重
伤的对手在绝望中徒劳挣扎。
在一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工执行近战，并在
您使用关键成功进行出击后，如果敌方特工没有
被残废，那么可以使用本交战计谋。结束那个流
程（任何残余的攻击骰子将被弃置），并立即
执行一个距离至多为 3" 的无消耗后撤行动（近
战行动随之结束）。那名特工即便先前执行了会
阻止它执行后撤行动的行动也不会影响本规则
效果。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
THE CURTAIN FALLS
Upon landing a devastating blow, the Harlequin
disengages, leaving their wounded opponent flailing
desperately in response.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative is fighting,
after you strike with a critical success, if the
enemy operative isn’t incapacitated. End
that sequence (any remaining attack dice are
discarded) and immediately perform a free Fall
Back action up to 3" with that operative (then the
Fight action ends). That operative can do so even
if it’s performed an action that prevents it from
performing the Fall Back action.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
交战计谋
灵活目标
迅捷而优雅的丑角穿梭于掩体之间，轻易躲
开敌人。
在一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工激活时使用本交
战计谋。直到它的下一次激活前，如果这名特工
拥有隐匿命令且处于掩护中，便无法被选为有效
目标，本规则的优先度高于所有其他规则（例
如‘追踪’武器规则和制高点地形)，除非攻击者
位于特工的 2" 内。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ELUSIVE TARGET
Swift, agile and graceful, Harlequins dart from cover to
cover, evading their opponents with contemptuous ease.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative’s activation.
Until the start of its next activation, while that
operative has a Conceal order and is in cover,
it cannot be selected as a valid target, taking
precedence over all other rules (e.g. Seek,
Vantage terrain) except being within 2".

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
交战计谋
多米诺力场
丑角们携带着各种各样的神秘装备，而多米诺
力场是其中最为常见的，这种装置能使他们轮
廓破碎，难以瞄准。
在一名特工对一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工执行
射击的结算防御骰子步骤中使用本交战计谋。您
可以使用一枚己方成功的骰子格挡所有您对手与
其数字相同的结果（例：您成功的一枚防御骰子
结果为 5，则它可以格挡所有结果为 5 的成功攻
击骰子）。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DOMINO FIELD
Harlequins bear a variety of esoteric equipment,
including the ubiquitous Domino Field, which breaks up
their outline and renders them difficult to target.
Use this firefight ploy when an operative is
shooting a friendly VOID-DANCER TROUPE
operative, during the Resolve Defence Dice step.
You can allocate one of your rolled successful
dice to block all of your opponent's attack dice
with matching results (e.g. one of your successful
defence dice results of 5 can be used to block all
successful attack dice results of 5).

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
阵营装备
灵骨护符
这个蕴含灵能的物品能为持有者提供敏锐的洞
察力，使它们能用无比精准的方式打击对手。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方虚空舞者剧团
特工进行射击、近战或反击时，如果您掷出了两
枚或更多失败，您便可以弃置其中的一枚并将其
保留为普通成功作为替代。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
WRAITHBONE TALISMAN
Charged with psychic power, this item provides fleeting
insight to the bearer, enabling them to strike their
opponents with unerring accuracy.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative is shooting,
fighting or retaliating, if you roll two or more fails,
you can discard one of them to retain another as
a normal success instead.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
阵营装备
尖啸者毒素弹
这种覆上了基因剧毒的弹药能导致目标血肉扭
曲撕裂的毁灭效果。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方虚空舞者剧团
特工执行射击时选择了星镖手枪或尖啸者加农
炮（集中）时，您可以使用本规则。若此，直
到那个行动结束，那个武器获得“毁灭 1”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SHRIEKER TOXIN ROUNDS
Coated with virulent genetic toxins, these rounds cause
the flesh of the target to twist, distort and rupture to
devastating effect.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative is performing
the Shoot action and you select a shuriken pistol
or shrieker cannon (focused), you can use this
rule. If you do, until the end of that action, that
weapon has the Devastating 1 weapon rule.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
阵营装备
死亡面具
在少数情况下，一名丑角会为了完成剧目中的
角色而必须牺牲自己。这种献身精神会激励剧
团中幸存的伙伴。
请进行悲剧计数。每当拥有嘉奖规则的一名己方
虚空舞者剧团特工残废时，为悲剧计数增加 1
点。当您的悲剧计数到达 3 点时，您会获得 1 点
CP，并停止那个计数。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
DEATH MASK
On occasion, a Harlequin must perish in order to fulfil
their role in the saedath. Such dedication emboldens
those in their troupe that survive.
Keep a Tragedy tally. Whenever a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative that has an
ACCOLADE rule is incapacitated, add 1 to your
Tragedy tally. When your Tragedy tally reaches 3,
you gain 1CP and stop that tally.

cards.text:
虚空舞者剧团
阵营装备
候补面具
这个物件能使丑角们在剧目中改变角色。如果
有关键角色死去，那么另一名丑角会很快接替
其位置。
每场战斗限一次，当一名成为关键角色的己方特
工残废，则在激活一名己方虚空舞者剧团特工
时，您可以使用本规则。若此，那个激活特工在
本场战斗中成为关键角色。
cards.text_en:
VOID-DANCER TROUPE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
UNDERSTUDY’S MASK
This item allows Harlequins to change roles during the
saedath. Should one who holds a pivotal role be slain,
another will swiftly take their place.
Once per battle, when you activate a friendly
VOID-DANCER TROUPE operative, if the friendly
operative that has the PIVOTAL ROLE has been
incapacitated, you can use this rule. If you do,
that activated operative has the PIVOTAL ROLE
for the battle.
